title: W1NT3R H3LLSC4PE
description: A hellish Winter world where nothing can thrive, but will you be an exception ?
body:
The Year was Unknown, Humanity because of its own foolishness has plummeted into many disasters, now a modern day ice age that covers the Earth in its white snow sheets. That God knows how long it will take to melt.

  This is a survival modpack where you the player, has to survive in a minecraft world covered in snow and engulfed in an eternal winter. The world is devoid of life and your visibility is almost non existant. However, there are monsters that lurk within the murky depth of the snow. Moreover you can also get frosbitten to death too, so also be aware. But you are given steampunk technology, early rifles, potentially simple transportation and shelter. Can you survive this primal Winter. Overall, this modpack is great for both single player and multiplayer.

  Thank you for supporting me, a small indie Modpack Dev, also this is my first modpack, hope it goes well. :3
